messages:
marta: Quick sync after RFC — need to pick a routing model for admissions: central router vs distributed per-prober.

devin: Centralized gives easy dedupe + metrics, but is a single logical point to scale/HA.

alyssa: Distributed scales but we risk duplicate golden benches. Could we coordinate only for golden runs?

marta: Suggest tiny lease service: probers try to Acquire(model_id, role="golden"); winner runs canonical bench.

sam: If lease not acquired quickly, prober runs a provisional fast probe and marks results provisional until golden completes.

kevin: Ops note: leases should be short — propose 30s TTL with randomized backoff on retries.

alyssa: Routing keys must be size-aware (max_seq, param_bin) so large-footprint models hit large-GPU pools.

devin: Also add abi_hash into the fingerprint so router/pools match runtime ABI compatibility.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Router config update will trigger canary autoscaler 10->50; coordinate with eng-infra.

marta: Action items: devin prototype lease API (EOW), sam bench cache PR (Wed), alyssa tests matrix (Fri), kevin sync infra (tomorrow).
